content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Manchester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's prerequisites—typically a secondary degree plus years of directed project-work hours, or a four-year degree with fewer required hours. Granite PM Academy can help you verify your background against PMI standards before you invest in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Manchester-based trainers deliver all required contact hours synchronously, so you engage with instructors and peers in real time. Schedule flexibility accommodates working professionals; courses run weeknights and weekends to fit your calendar.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, submit your formal PMI application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff guide you through the application portal and answer procedural questions so the process moves smoothly.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation materials—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to solidify your readiness. Register for your PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in or near Manchester. Our instructors remain available for targeted Q&A before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible workshops and webinars so Manchester professionals can stay current without restarting from scratch.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
